environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with default configuration. ALB performs basic health checks and round-robin routing. No request inspection or transformation is applied at the load balancer layer. MongoDB Atlas cluster accessible from the VPC via peering connection. Service receives raw client requests forwarded by ALB with X-Forwarded-For headers only.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group)
config.database: MongoDB Atlas M10 cluster, no field-level encryption
config.network: VPC peering to Atlas, no WAF attached to ALB
config.auth: No API key requirement, endpoints publicly accessible
